summary:
Refactored UniTunnel Go Fyne UI:
- Configured .gitignore to isolate the pure Go codebase from web prototype scaffolding
- Changed window proportions to a vertical modern aspect ratio (365x640)
- Converted Settings and Logs from modal overlays to inline collapsible drawer panels
- Positioned the real-time bandwidth & ping chart strictly at the bottom
- Cleaned up account management selector and central connection cards
